description: This file defines React components for rendering different types of filter dividers (vertical, horizontal, overflow) in a dashboard's filter bar, with support for truncation and tooltips.

methods.name: VerticalDivider
methods.description: Renders a vertical divider with a title and optional description.

methods.name: HorizontalDivider
methods.description: Renders a horizontal divider with a title, optional description, and tooltip support.

methods.name: HorizontalOverflowDivider
methods.description: Renders a horizontal divider with overflow support, truncation, and tooltips for title and description.

methods.name: FilterDivider
methods.description: Main component that chooses which divider to render based on orientation and overflow props.
